shortDescription: Singapore's Maritime Rescue Coordination Centre coordinated the rescue of all 25 crew members from the Liberia-registered container vessel MSC HERMES III after receiving a distress alert on Tuesday, the Maritime and Port Authority said.

children: Singapore's Maritime Rescue Coordination Centre coordinated the rescue of all 25 crew members from the Liberia-registered container vessel MSC HERMES III after receiving a distress alert on Tuesday, the Maritime and Port Authority said.
The vessel was within Singapore’s maritime search and rescue region, about 300 km (185 miles) east of Vietnam, the port authority said.

The Maritime Rescue Coordination Centre issued a request for vessels in the vicinity to assist and three responded. The port authority said the MSC RUBY recovered the crew members, who were in a lifeboat.
All 25 crew members are safe with no injuries reported, the port authority said.
The port authority did not say what happened to the vessel.
